book_meta.work: Le Tour du monde en quatre-vingts jours
book_meta.author: Jules Verne

sentences.en: At Suez, on the quay, two men stood.
One the British consul.

sentences.ar: والتاني رجل زغير، نحيف، عينه صغيرة وحادة.
sentences.en: And the other a small, thin man, with small sharp eyes.
His name was Fix, a detective from Scotland Yard.

sentences.ar: بعتوه للسويس، عشان يراقب كل باخرة جاية من أوروبا.
sentences.en: They had sent him to Suez, to watch every steamer from Europe.
And he had the thief's description.

sentences.ar: وقال للقنصل: بحس إنه على هالباخرة.
sentences.en: And he said to the consul: I feel he is on this steamer.

sentences.ar: قال القنصل: كل مفتش بيحس هيك.
sentences.en: The consul said: every detective feels so.

sentences.ar: قال فيكس: بس أنا معي حق.
sentences.en: Fix said: but I am right.
The thief is a gentleman.
And gentlemen travel like gentlemen.
The Mongolia arrived.

sentences.ar: ونزل الركاب، وفيكس بيتطلع بكل وجه.
sentences.en: And the passengers got off, and Fix looked at every face.

sentences.ar: وإجا عليه شاب، وبإيده جواز سفر.
sentences.en: And a young man came up to him, a passport in his hand.
Passepartout.
He said: excuse me, where is the consulate?
I need a stamp on my master's passport.
Fix took the passport, and read it.
Phileas Fogg.
The height, the hair, the face.
The description exactly.
And his hand shook.
Fix said: this is your master's passport?
He must come himself.
Passepartout said: must he?
Fine, I will bring him.
And Fix ran to the consul.
And said: it is him!
I have found him!
Phileas Fogg!
Do not stamp his passport!
The consul said: the passport is in order.
I must stamp it.

sentences.ar: قال فيكس: خليه هون لحد ما توصل المذكرة من لندن!
sentences.en: Fix said: keep him here until the warrant arrives from London!
The consul said: that is not my business.

sentences.ar: وإجا فوغ، هادي، وحط الجواز، والقنصل ختمه.
sentences.en: And Fogg came, calm, put down the passport, and the consul stamped it.
And Fogg said: thank you.
And went back to the steamer.
And Fix stood watching him go.
And said: a cold man.
No thief is so cold.

sentences.ar: إلا إذا كان أذكى حرامي بالدنيا.
sentences.en: Unless he is the cleverest thief in the world.
And decided: I follow him.
To Bombay.
To the end of the world.
And sent the telegram to London.
And boarded the Mongolia.
